name: architecture-fidelity
description: Skills for architectural coherence and evidence-based repository assessment.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve architecture and assess repository trust.
interface.longDescription: Includes architecture-fidelity for coherent implementation and architecture reviews, and repo-review for source-backed assessments of functionality, practical value, security, privacy, and adoption fit. Each skill loads detailed guidance only when needed.
defaultPrompt: Implement this feature with architectural fidelity.
Check whether this completed diff warrants an architecture fidelity pass.
Review this change for architectural drift.
Find the right reuse or abstraction seam here.
Assess this repository’s functionality, practical value, and security.
